'''Project Orrad''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] project and base located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Venaari]]. Project Orrad was protected by ''[[Retaliator]]'', an [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]].
